changelog:
When a stream fails on the television, this phone now finds out why.

WHAT CHANGED

- If the television reports a failed stream, the phone quietly tries the
  same channel itself, with the same details, and then tells you what it
  learned: whether the channel plays on the phone (so the stream is
  alive and the problem is between the provider and the television), or
  whether it fails here too (so the channel itself is the problem).
- The television's own report is shown alongside, in its own words:
  what the server answered, or that it did not answer at all.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else. Sending, pairing and playback are unchanged; you
  only see anything new when a cast actually fails.
